basic_details.job_title: PGIMER Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Research Associate and Accountant and More Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Post Graduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER) Chandigarh
basic_details.short_information: Post Graduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER) Chandigarh has released the PGIMER Recruitment 2026 notification for 6 contractual vacancies, including Research Associate, Accountant, and other project positions. Candidates with qualifications such as Graduation, Master's degree, MPH, Food & Nutrition, Dietetics, Statistics, PhD, or relevant work experience are eligible to apply, depending on the post. The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 6,000 to Rs. 40,000. Interested candidates can check the detailed eligibility criteria, vacancy details,

qualification.details: Project Technical Officer: Master's degree in Food & Nutrition, preferably with PhD. Accountant cum Administrative Staff: Graduation with Minimum 5 years of experience in office administration, project administration, accounts, documentation, or secretarial work. Project Technical Officer (Part Time): Master's degree in Food & Nutrition, Statistics, Preferably PhD. Retired officers from FSSAI can be considered. Research Associate (Part Time): Postgraduate degree in Health (MPH), Nutrition, Dietetics, Food & Nutrition, from a recognized University/Institute. Retired officers from FSSAI can be considered. Administrative Assistant (Part Time): Graduation with one year experience in office administration, accounts and documentation.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Various Project Positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the PGIMER Various Project Positions is 29th July 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the PGIMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for various project positions at PGIMER, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary structure for the Project Technical Officer post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Technical Officer post is Rs. 40000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Are there any application fees for the PGIMER recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there are no application fees mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Accountant cum Administrative Staff position?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for the Accountant cum Administrative Staff position is Graduation with at least 5 years of experience in office administration, project administration, accounts, documentation, or secretarial work.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. When will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted on 31st July 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Can retired officers from FSSAI apply for the Project Technical Officer (Part Time) and Research Associate (Part Time) posts?
faq.answer: Yes, retired officers from FSSAI can be considered for the Project Technical Officer (Part Time) and Research Associate (Part Time) positions.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be accessed through the links provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
